summary: Near-black canvas, one neutral inverted CTA and no chromatic brand accent, 6px radius on everything that is not a pill, a 14px/20px UI size that repeats more than every heading combined, and full-bleed bands rather than cards.
coverageNote: Light theme was observed at desktop only; mobile was observed in dark only. Nothing between 390px and 1440px was measured, so every breakpoint claim is estimated. The observation captures computed values on one landing page, not the design system behind it.

interactive.role: secondary (canvas-coloured fill, e.g. the two header actions beside the primary)

rawObservations.roleAttributionNote: Role names were verified on 2026-09-06 by reading the button labels directly: the primary 'Sign Up' button renders background rgb(237,237,237) with label rgb(10,10,10) in dark and background rgb(23,23,23) with label rgb(255,255,255) in light. The more frequent pair (x6) is the SECONDARY treatment used by 'Get a Demo' and 'Log In'. Frequency alone does not identify the primary action.

--background.note: exact conversion of the observed canvas: dark rgb(10,10,10), light rgb(255,255,255)

--card.note: the second surface observed against the canvas: dark rgb(0,0,0) ×5, light rgb(250,250,250) ×5. Dark goes darker than the canvas, light goes lighter — the ladder runs away from the page colour in both themes

--foreground.note: exact conversion of rgb(237,237,237) / rgb(23,23,23), the most frequent text colour in each theme (135 nodes)

--muted-foreground.note: rgb(161,161,161) / rgb(77,77,77) on 115 nodes — nearly as frequent as --foreground, so secondary text is a first-class role, not an afterthought

--primary.note: the primary CTA is the inverted neutral: observed background rgb(237,237,237) with label rgb(10,10,10) in dark, and background rgb(23,23,23) with label rgb(255,255,255) in light, on 4 controls. Verified by label ('Sign Up'), not by frequency: the more common 6-occurrence pair is the secondary treatment. There is no chromatic brand accent on the primary action.

--primary-foreground.note: the label colour observed on the inverted primary fill above (dark rgb(10,10,10), light rgb(255,255,255)).

--info.note: dark value is the exact conversion of the observed rgb(82,168,255), the single chromatic control observed (1 occurrence). The light value is NOT observed: it is the same hue and chroma darkened to hold 4.5:1 on the observed white canvas. Grade is estimated because half the pair is derived.

--radius.note: 6px on 47 of 78 rounded corners; 8px ×4 and 4px ×1 are the exceptions

--radius-pill.note: 25 small controls observed with an effectively infinite radius. Only small controls are pills; cards stay at --radius

--space-unit.note: derived, not measured: the observed histogram is 2px ×249, 6px ×225, 4px ×164, 12px ×60, 8px ×19, 24px ×14. The frequent steps are 2·4·6·12·24, so a 2px resolution with a 4px working unit reproduces the rhythm. The site's own scale was not read

--font-sans.note: GeistSans on 248 of 268 text nodes. The role is a neutral grotesque; the name is one implementation of it

--font-mono.note: Geist Mono on 20 nodes: code, technical labels, small captions

--secondary.note: the secondary action fills with the canvas colour and carries --foreground as its label: observed background rgb(10,10,10)/label rgb(237,237,237) dark and rgb(255,255,255)/rgb(23,23,23) light on 6 controls. It reads as a bordered button, not a filled one.

--secondary-foreground.note: label colour on the secondary fill above.

typeScale.note: largest rendered size 64px @1440 and 48px @390 (a 0.75 ratio). Weight 450 — the display is large and light, not heavy. Line height and tracking at this size were not in the frequent-value table
36 nodes at 1440 and absent from the mobile top-8: the lead paragraph is a desktop affordance
102 + 30 nodes, the most frequent pair by far: the interface speaks at 14px and headings are the exception
9 nodes; the only positive tracking observed. Small labels track wider, everything else tracks tighter

maxWidth.value: 1392px content band inside a 1440px viewport (24px gutters); header and footer run full-bleed

slots.note: 836px at both observed widths. Whether the height is fixed or coincidental was not tested — only two widths were measured

slots.role: the long middle: repeated feature bands
slots.note: one section owning ~44% of a 5333px page. The page is mostly this band
the footer more than doubles on mobile: link columns stack rather than collapse into an accordion

layout.macro: sticky-header → hero → long capability stack → proof → closing CTA → tall sitemap footer

primary-cta.pattern: Inverted neutral fill (foreground colour as background, background colour as label), --radius, no gradient, no chromatic accent.

secondary-cta.pattern: Same size beside the primary, filled with the canvas colour and labelled with --foreground, so it reads as an outline button rather than a second filled one.
secondary-cta.note: 6 controls observed with background = the canvas colour; the border treatment itself was not measured.

surface.pattern: Depth from a surface ladder plus hairline borders at --radius, not from shadows.
surface.note: two surfaces per theme were observed; no shadow was measured, so 'no shadows' is an inference from their absence in the corner tally

pill.pattern: Fully rounded small controls (badges, tags, chips). Cards never become pills.

mono-label.pattern: Monospace for technical labels, code and small captions; never for prose.

responsive.change: Display drops 64px → 48px; the 20px lead role leaves the frequent scale; band heights are otherwise unchanged.
Footer grows 846px → 1958px as link columns stack. The header stays 64px and sticky.
Assume the multi-column → single-column switch happens here.

content.images: Landscape media at roughly 16:9 on desktop (observed 1.78, 1.90) and 1.25 on mobile: product surfaces, not photography. Reserve the ratio and use a neutral placeholder block.
content.copy: Short technical noun phrases, sentence case, no exclamation marks.
content.note: the aspect ratios are observed; the copy character describes a role and reproduces nothing

taskTransfer.sameTask: developer-platform-marketing — use the layout slots as ordered.
taskTransfer.otherTasks: For a product surface (dashboard, console, settings), keep tokens, radius, spacing rhythm and the ui/caption/eyebrow type roles. Drop the display and section-heading sizes, the hero and the marketing band order: a 64px display in a dashboard is this pack applied to the wrong task.

allowedModifications: Raise contrast when a value falls below 4.5:1 text / 3:1 UI, and record the deviation.
Grow a tap target to 24px (44px mobile) while keeping the visual size.
Add the focus-visible, loading, empty and error states the observation could not see.
Use 16px instead of the observed 14px UI size when the audience is not developers.
Substitute any neutral grotesque for Geist: the role is the spec, the name is the implementation.
Drop the marketing type hierarchy when the target task is a product surface (see taskTransfer).
forbidden: Copying the Vercel logo, the triangle mark, product screenshots or any page copy.
Describing an estimated value as observed — the grade travels with the value.
Using a chromatic brand accent as the primary CTA: the observed primary action is the inverted neutral.
Presenting the marketing display scale as evidence for a dashboard or console.

primitives.name: Geist
primitives.pinNote: Version read from the npm package `geist`; the license was verified on the main branch, so pin the version you install and re-verify if you take a different tag.
